change_summary: The paper has been withdrawn, and its title now begins 'WITHDRAWN:'. The editor was told that the indoor temperature records had been processed with an incorrect sensor calibration, so the reported results cannot be relied on, and the full text was replaced by a statement. This touches the whole paper, including the 2.1 °C lower peak indoor temperature and the 41% fewer hours above 28 °C, because they rest on those records.
evaluation: Your Section 2.2 cites Okafor et al. [14] for the 2.1 °C reduction in daily peak indoor temperature that you set as the green-roof cooling effect in your model. The withdrawal says the indoor temperature records had an incorrect sensor calibration, so the results cannot be relied on, which touches that parameter. Your Discussion says the green-roof result scales almost directly with that same 2.1 °C figure, so it is touched too. The impact on your draft is high, because your central estimate and its conclusion rest on that value.
recommendation: The paper has been withdrawn, and the withdrawal says the indoor temperature records had an incorrect sensor calibration, so the results cannot be relied on. Your Section 2.2 sets the model's green-roof cooling effect to the 2.1 °C taken from it, so that use is touched. Your Discussion says the green-roof result scales almost directly with the same 2.1 °C figure, so it is touched too. Raise this with your co-authors or supervisor before changing the text, find a reliable replacement value, re-run the model, and then remove or replace citation [14].
